title: Retention efforts support fall enrollment of 30,772
summary_en: Iowa State University’s fall enrollment reflects its commitment to helping students earn their degree with a one-year retention rate of 88.3% and record two-year retention of 82.9%. Iowa State’s total enrollment of 30,772 includes a first-year class of 5,872 students.
